SELECT 
  overall_avg_ratio,
  avg_line_items_per_order_item
FROM (
  SELECT 
    AVG(line_item_count) as avg_line_items_per_order_item,
    AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg_ratio
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      order_item_id,
      COUNT(*) as line_item_count,
      AVG(CASE 
        WHEN derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0 AND product_price IS NOT NULL
        THEN CAST(product_price AS REAL) / CAST(derived_total_cost AS REAL)
        ELSE NULL
      END) as avg_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  )
)
